allocation_complete.reason: The element has no allocates link.

completeness.reason: The 100 ms disconnect deadline of the parent is not addressed anywhere in the element.
completeness.suggestion: Add the 100 ms deadline and how the coordinator meets it.

consistency.reason: Sibling BB_HV_PROTECTION (same parent) says the BMS 'opens the contactors within its own reaction time', while this element says the VCU commands the contactors open; ownership of the contactor-open command is unreconciled.
consistency.suggestion: Decide who commands the contactors on an isolation fault (VCU or BMS) and align both elements.

design_clarity.reason: Names the reaction (command main contactors open) but not the input channel (signal/message) nor how the 100 ms budget is split between reception, decision and contactor actuation.
design_clarity.suggestion: Name the isolation-fault signal path and the VCU timing budget (e.g. reaction <= x ms of the 100 ms).

implementability.reason: Realisable, but because contactor ownership is split with the BMS black box the implementer must decide whether the VCU command is primary or redundant.
implementability.suggestion: Resolve the contactor ownership and state it.

interface_only.reason: The element has no allocates link.

no_value_copy.reason: No BMS value (limit, threshold, timing) is named.

parent_fit.reason: Receives the BMS isolation fault and commands the main contactors open, i.e. disconnects the HV battery as REQ_HV_SHUTDOWN_ON_ISOLATION_FAULT asks.
